reference_root.description: Optional root directory for shared reference genomes, STAR indexes, and polyA databases (set per server profile or via --reference_root).

reference_build.description: Optional genome build subdirectory under reference_root (for example GRCh38 or GRCm38).

genome_fasta.description: Reference genome FASTA (absolute path or relative to reference_root; auto-resolved when reference_root and reference_build are set).

gtf.description: Reference annotation GTF (absolute path or relative to reference_root; auto-resolved when reference_root and reference_build are set).

chrom_sizes.description: Optional precomputed chromosome sizes TSV (validated against genome_fasta when supplied).

star_index.description: Optional prebuilt STAR index directory (validated for format and chromosome compatibility before reuse).

known_polya.description: Optional legacy known polyA atlas or PAS reference.

polya_db.description: Optional PolyA_DB precision source. Use a local file, URL, or 'download' for the built-in human PAS URL.

polyasite.description: Optional PolyASite recall source. Use a local file, URL, or 'download' for the built-in GRCh38 GENCODE 42 atlas URL.

pas_reference_cache_dir.description: Optional cache directory for downloaded PolyA_DB and PolyASite archives.

strandedness.description: Library strandedness override (forward, reverse, or unstranded). When null, inferred from chemistry (reverse for 10xv1, forward otherwise).

scapture_strand.description: Optional SCAPTURE-specific strandedness override; falls back to strandedness / chemistry inference.

scapture_execution_mode.description: SCAPTURE execution path. The staged mode requires --enable_scapture true and resumes each stage independently with Nextflow -resume.

scapture_catalog_only.description: Staged SCAPTURE only: build evaluated BEDs, PAS reference, and normalized site catalog without running PASquant quantification.

scapture_normality_seed.description: Base seed for reproducible SCAPTURE Normality.R sampling in staged mode; each transcript gets a stable derived seed.
